proposedDefects.brief: the same generic M3 screw appears under four different part numbers, with different units (metric vs inch)
proposedDefects.data: extended.entityResolution: D-38014, FR3811 (metric) and ES-3826, UK/3823 (inch); supplierParts give ES and UK the same supplier part number
proposedDefects.needs: part dimension, material and standard columns mapped to atelier:dimensionText, atelier:material and atelier:fastenerStandard with unit parsing of the native decimal and inch formats, a supplier-part table per PLM in the layer, and a resolution query (same standard and converted size within 0.05 mm, or same supplier part number) producing atelier:sameItemAs candidates

proposedDefects.brief: one purchased item has two suppliers with conflicting lead times in the same PLM
proposedDefects.data: extended.supplierParts.DE: D-38007 has lieferantenteil rows from L-02 (QN-6001-2RS, 10 days) and L-01 (ZK-L-6001, 35 days), both bevorzugt; the part's own lieferzeit_tage is 10
proposedDefects.needs: the supplier-part table above mapped to atelier:SupplierPart with atelier:leadTimeDays and atelier:preferred, and a shape failing a part with more than one preferred supplier part or with preferred lead times that disagree

proposedDefects.brief: a DE gearmotor references a UK controller connector revision that is SUPERSEDED
proposedDefects.data: externalRefs D-38001 -> urn:plm:uk:part:UK/3828 expects P1; UK/3828 is at C1 and lists P1 and P2 under supersededRevisions
proposedDefects.needs: revision and lifecycle columns on the PLM part tables mapped to atelier:revision and a canonical atelier:lifecycle, an external-reference table per PLM (externer_verweis, reference_externe, referencia_externa, external_ref) in the link graph with atelier:expectedRevision, and a shape failing when the expected revision is not the remote part's current one

proposedDefects.brief: an FR wheel references an ES part that exists only as a Draft
proposedDefects.data: externalRefs FR3801 -> urn:plm:es:part:ES-3833 expects revision 1; ES-3833 is Borrador and appears in no ES lista_materiales
proposedDefects.needs: the external-reference table above and the canonical lifecycle, with a shape failing a reference from a RELEASED part to a remote part whose lifecycle is WORKING

proposedDefects.brief: UK battery pack capacity is stored as text with a unit suffix
proposedDefects.data: UK/3805 extended.attributes.capacity = "12.0 Ah" (a string) where nominalVoltage is numeric
proposedDefects.needs: a part attribute table per PLM (name, value, unit) mapped to qudt:QuantityValue, a parser that splits a text value into number and unit, and a shape failing an attribute whose value is not numeric or whose unit is not a known QUDT unit

proposedDefects.brief: supplier exposure: parts per supplier and single-source risks across sites
proposedDefects.data: extended.supplierParts: every row of D-38001 and D-38002 (ten gearmotors) names Zinnkraut Antriebstechnik; UK/3805 (battery) names Dunmere Power Systems alone
proposedDefects.needs: the supplier-part table above in the layer and a query grouping parts by supplier across PLMs, flagging a purchased part with exactly one supplier part row
